phrases.english: 1.O God, I ask pardon from You for

phrases.arabic: مِنْ مَـظْلُوم ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ،
phrases.english: 2.the person wronged in my presence whom I did not help,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوف أُسْدِيَ  إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ،
phrases.english: 3.the favour conferred upon me for which I returned no thanks,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ مُسِيء أعْتَذَرَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ،
phrases.english: 4.the evildoer who asked pardon from me and whom I did not pardon,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَة سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ اُوثِرْهُ،
phrases.english: 5.the needy person who asked from me and whom I preferred not over myself,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذي حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِن فَلَمْ أوَفِّـرْهُ،
phrases.english: 6.the right of a believer who possesses a right incumbent upon me which I did not fulfil,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِن ظَهَر لِي فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ،
phrases.english: 7.the fault of a believer which became evident to me and which I did not conceal,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ  إثْم عَرَضَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ.
phrases.english: 8.and every sin which presented itself to me and which I failed to avoid.
9.I ask pardon, my God, for all of these
10.and their likes, with an asking of pardon in remorse

phrases.arabic: يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ.
phrases.english: 11.which may act as an admonisher against similar things ahead of me.

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ  فِيهِ مِنَ الـزَّلاّتِ
phrases.english: 13.and make my remorse for the slips into which I have fallen

phrases.arabic: وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَـرْكِ مَا يَعْـرِضُ لِيْ مِنَ السَّيِّئـاتِ
phrases.english: 14.and my determination to refrain from the evil deeds which present themselves to me
15.a repentance which will make Your love for me obligatory,
